_doc: Per-repo profile: everything repo-specific the engine needs. Engine code stays generic. Types: str, list, dict, bool. 'required' fields must be present; each top-level field may have a sibling '<field>_confidence': read|guess. A10: dependency_lockfiles = aggregate lockfiles whose change only affects the areas whose dependency manifest changed in the same PR (no manifest changed -> full). tooling_scopes values may be a string or a list of test folders. M5 (2026-10-11): area_rules = several area rules, first match wins (monorepos: one per workspace group); always_run = test globs added to every non-full selection (tests whose inputs neither map sees, e.g. they read repo files from disk). B (langchain, 2026-10-11): import_roots = dirs on sys.path (monorepo packages, `*` segments expanded); static import names are relative to them and resolve in the importing file's own package first.
